scope: Control-queue saturation, replacement offers and panic delivery under playback edit bursts
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none; host load not controlled

thread-sanitizer.note: Local -fsanitize=thread build of edit-burst-tests, three runs, no reports

verified_behaviors: A full queue accepts exactly 64 controls, then refuses controls (including Stop) and replacement offers; panic silences the next block and discards the queue
After panic a replacement and fresh controls are accepted and apply under the new plan
A replacement held behind a far-future frame delays a queued Stop but not panic, which activates it and silences

Threaded bursts: 3000 rounds, bursts up to 72 controls, 60 panics each silenced within 2 render blocks of the request with a silent stopped block; 8136 refused controls, 2296 busy and 704 accepted offers in the recorded engine-only run
No allocation or release intercepted on the render thread

Desktop: flooding Launch reports 'Control queue full', Stop is refused the same way, a live edit is kept and handed over after panic frees the queue, Silence now stops, and Immediate scene launch recovers
Mutation caught: gating panic behind a held replacement fails the held-replacement check

measured.note: Host measurements on Kvant, not a deadline qualification
measured.worst_replacement: 64 MIDI tracks x 1024 notes with sounding voices, reversed track order, 64 queued commands

limits: Software test processes and preview UI; no real-time scheduling, physical audio or controlled host load; block timings are single-run maxima.
